_comment: GraphJudge Track C — Butterbase schema source of truth (contracts.md §4.5). Column names/types here match the FROZEN contract: credits_ledger(id,user_id,delta,reason,created_at); jobs(job_id pk,user_id,status,created_at); results(job_id pk,verdict jsonb,created_at). user_id/job_id are TEXT so contract ids like job_id='j_001' (§4.1) and arbitrary webhook user_id (§4.4) are accepted. NOTE: the live app app_r1568bo1iteg was pre-provisioned with a DEVIATING schema (user_id/job_id=uuid, credits_ledger.ts instead of created_at, results.verdict_json instead of verdict, extra results.user_id). Reconciling to this file requires DROPping the (empty) shared tables, which needs explicit human authorization — see dev-C.md NEEDS-HUMAN. Feed the `tables`/`_drop` object below to manage_schema apply once authorized.
